locations.note: The animals land on Madagascar and play through its beach, jungle, the lemur party and the fossa lair.
The police tranquilise the animals and ship them out of New York, and a bonus task has Gloria destroying vehicles in the city.
The game starts with Marty escaping the Central Park Zoo on his tenth birthday, and the others go looking for him.

routes.name: The zoo animals
routes.note: From the Central Park Zoo to Madagascar.
